issue.title: Flaky models_panel_provider_disabled visual readiness timeout in CI
issue.description: The approved green-master CI plan records a CI-only visual readiness race: models_panel_provider_disabled timed out waiting for the Launch Control provider disable title line in CI while local reproduction was an ordinary PNG mismatch. Do not paper over it in the snapshot rebaseline; stabilize or isolate the readiness wait separately.

task_type_fields.evidence: CI run reported: Timed out after 15.00s waiting for Launch Control provider disable title line. On the same investigation, local serial reproduction failed only as an ordinary PNG mismatch rather than a readiness timeout. Treat this as an intermittent CI readiness race under the visual worker pool, not as stale golden content.
